{"compatibility":"major","safety_note_md":"# SafeStan Safety Note

Compatibility: major.

Protected data: `y`.

Generated files: none.

Reason: the observation model is a marginalized hidden Markov model likelihood implemented through `normal_lpdf(...)` calculations in `transformed parameters` and a manual `target += log_sum_exp(logalpha[T])` update. SafeStan forbids arbitrary `target +=` scoring and requires protected observations to be scored exactly once by a built-in sampling statement before other use. Replacing this forward-algorithm marginal likelihood with SafeStan sampling statements would require a substantive model rewrite/change rather than a minor same-density translation. In addition, several parameters do not have explicit SafeStan-compatible priors in the model block, and adding proper priors would change the density.
","model_safe_stan":"","data_safe_json":"","protected_variables":[]}

data_safe_json.description: Valid JSON object text for data_safe.json, or empty string for major rewrites.

protected_variables.description: Top-level data variables to pass to --sstan-protect.
